purpose: Replace the ambiguous offensive waiver activation flag with exact-scoring, horizon-correct forecast eligibility and independently governed format, recommendation, and transaction gates.

legacy_target_defects: groups by player rather than player-season
uses the next observed player rows rather than the next three scoring weeks
can skip bye, absence, and zero-opportunity weeks
allows one- or two-row partial horizons under a three-game label

canonical_target.name: fp_next3_weeks_exact
canonical_target.meaning: mean exact league fantasy points across the next three NFL regular-season scoring weeks after the decision week
canonical_target.runtime_short_horizon_policy: If fewer than three regular-season weeks remain, require a separately validated one- or two-week horizon model; never relabel a partial horizon as next three weeks.

exact_scoring.policy: Every nonzero rule relevant to the position must be exactly reconstructed before that scoring-signature/position label is eligible. Coverage percentages cannot waive one unsupported rule.
exact_scoring.profile_reuse: Models may be shared only across byte-equivalent scoring signatures and identical position relevance.
source_requirements: event attribution and participation when weekly aggregates are insufficient
no double counting between specific return-touchdown fields and aggregate special-teams fields
rare-event reconciliation against an independent aggregate or provider result when available
unknown and incomplete observations remain null
exact_scoring.activation_binding: The direct point forecast binds to its exact scoring signature and label-builder version. It does not depend on the M4 predicted-raw-stat scorer gate at inference time.

model_validation.candidate_model: Existing Ridge architecture may be the first challenger, but legacy coefficients and promotion results do not transfer to the corrected target.
model_validation.temporal_design: whole-season expanding outer folds with at least two prior training seasons and at least four valid holdout seasons
model_validation.selection_design: features, regularization, imputation, and live coverage thresholds are selected only inside prior-season training data or nested inner folds
model_validation.baseline: same-row fp_prior_4 scored with the same exact league profile

requirements: declare required and optional features per position
validate live missingness patterns against training support
lock the selected threshold before outer-fold evaluation
require fp_prior_4 plus at least one position-relevant opportunity or role feature

model_validation.position_policy: QB, RB, WR, and TE each re-earn eligibility. TE remains blocked unless the corrected exact-target evaluation passes every gate.
leakage_guards: no selecting the best candidate on final outer folds

requires: current history and feature coverage pass

legacy.meaning: backward-compatible alias of waiver_recommendation_eligible, never waiver_forecast_eligible
legacy.reason: legacy planners must not consume forecast-only rows

REDRAFT.recommendation: eligible_only_after_redraft waiver decision validation and legal replacement evidence

DYNASTY.recommendation: blocked until future production, age, asset-market, and multi-season utility are validated

REDRAFT_BESTBALL.recommendation: blocked until spike distribution, roster fit, and automatic-lineup contribution are validated
REDRAFT_BESTBALL.forbidden_claim: best-ball acquisition utility from mean projection alone

DYNASTY_BESTBALL.recommendation: requires both dynasty and best-ball decision gates

CHOPPED.ranking: mean production ranking only unless downside evidence also passes
CHOPPED.recommendation: blocked until roster-level survival, expected shortfall, and future supply effects are validated
CHOPPED.forbidden_claim: optimal survival bid from player mean alone

CHOPPED_BESTBALL.recommendation: requires both chopped and best-ball decision gates

planner_contract.candidate_filter: waiver_recommendation_eligible must be true; waiver_forecast_eligible alone is insufficient
planner_contract.drop_comparison: candidate and drop player require the same scoring signature, horizon, model version, and recommendation domain
planner_contract.free_agent_universe: captured cutoff-current Sleeper ownership, not an all-player proxy
planner_contract.optimal_label: forbidden until the waiver decision contract is met prospectively
planner_contract.bid_policy: Empirical observed winning bids may remain research evidence; sparse or private losing bids cannot be imputed, and a forecast edge alone cannot authorize an optimal FAAB recommendation.

runtime_contract.summary_counts: report each layer by position and format; never summarize non-offensive eligible rows as offensive waiver readiness
runtime_contract.ui_policy: show forecast-only evidence with its horizon and blocker; hide bid/drop/optimal language unless recommendation eligibility is true

implementation_sequence: Terra: add failing target-semantics and eligibility-layer contract tests without changing live eligibility
Terra: build a versioned dense player-week exact outcome ledger and scoring-rule inventory for all enabled scoring signatures
Terra: implement and reconcile missing offensive scoring components; keep unsupported signature/positions blocked
Terra: build corrected one-, two-, and three-week labels with same-season and completeness guards
Terra: retrain and nested-temporally validate M5 waiver challengers per scoring signature and position
Terra: publish new immutable M5 waiver-v2 artifacts and validators without rewriting legacy M5
Terra: add layered current-snapshot fields and preserve legacy fail-closed planner behavior
Terra: update Window 1C/1D diagnostics and make Window 1D require recommendation eligibility
Terra: accrue prospective free-agent, replacement, bid, and outcome evidence for decision-domain promotion
Sol: review any promotion request only after the declared sample and temporal thresholds are met
minimum_preservation_tests: week 18 never shifts into next season
bye and confirmed no-stat weeks are retained as explicit zero outcomes
missing source or unresolved roster identity never becomes zero
one- and two-week horizons are never labelled next three weeks
scoring signatures remain isolated under A-to-B-to-A processing
every nonzero relevant scoring key is supported or produces a typed blocker
bonus_rush_td_qb is never treated as relevant to RB, WR, or TE
return and special-teams touchdowns are not double counted
forecast-only dynasty, best-ball, and chopped rows cannot enter the recommendation planner
TE remains blocked when its validation status is diagnostic
missing live features are not zero-imputed into eligibility
candidate and drop projections must share horizon and scoring/model lineage

authorized: versioned research outcome ledger and exact scorer
corrected waiver labels and challenger validation
not_authorized: relaxing the current scoring gate without exact labels
carrying forward legacy M5 promotion statuses
dynasty, best-ball, or chopped recommendation claims from short-horizon mean forecasts
